svg.aria-label: ArcMD Library: clicking the Library button turns the sidebar into a wall of space cards, each in its own colors; clicking a page in another space jumps straight to it

g.text: Writing can be simple. Open a page
Good tools keep you on the content.
Break a big thing into steps.
Books that changed how I see things, one page each.
A novel about trees, and the slow, quiet attention
Read slowly. Keep one line you want to remember.
“The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago.”
